title: World XI
description: Every club of 24 big leagues — 18 men's and 6 women's, across four continents — plotted at its home stadium on a 3D globe, crests and all, from hand-curated rosters and Wikidata.

title: The Century of Africa
description: A scroll-driven tour of Africa's population century: UN projections to 2100, the megacities rising past every Western city, the corridors they will need, and Kinshasa's growth on the ground from GHSL satellite epochs.

title: Torn Down / Built Back
description: Detroit's block-by-block structure loss and replacement, 1870-2026, on half-mile hexes normalised against the buildings actually standing — sixteen metrics, decennial census cross-check, and a measured colourblind-safe ramp.

title: Train Route Atlas
description: Twelve legendary train routes — high-speed, scenic, night, and classic — draped over an interactive 3D globe with specs, filters, and popups, all client-side.

title: State Extremes
description: Four tips per place — north, east, south, west — for U.S. states and every country, with coverage toggles, rankings, and anomalies on a 3D globe.

title: Geopuesto Playground
description: Spherical-geometry experiments for great circles, equidistant points, polyhedra, and curve analysis on a globe.

title: U.S. Fantasy Transit Network
description: A generated four-tier North American transit network connecting Census places at continental, regional, metro, and commuter scales.

title: Concord Civil War
description: An alternate-history scrollytelling map that divides Concord, New Hampshire along the Merrimack River.

title: Bug Wars
description: A compact browser strategy game about building an insect colony and surviving rival swarms.

title: Bottle Game
description: A bottle-flip party game — flick for a clean 360°, land upright, and steal lives across the table. Win a game to unlock the parrot skin. Installable PWA with Matter.js physics.

title: Whydah's Voyage
description: Steer Black Sam Bellamy's 1717 voyage from the Caribbean to Maine — ten missions, ship battles, and the nor'easter the real crew never beat.

title: True Scale
description: A map experiment for comparing the apparent and actual size of places across latitudes.

title: Sequential Interstate Challenge
description: Drive every two-digit Interstate end to end — an optimized order and orientation cuts connector drive time 86% versus strict numerical order.

title: Mapzimus Board
description: The lab's idea engine — a live board that scores roughly 20,000 candidate map ideas by predicted virality with a weighted seven-dimension V-Score.

title: Boston in Motion
description: One live map of everything moving through Boston — MBTA trains, buses, ferries, Amtrak, planes over Logan, harbor AIS, and Bluebikes, all client-side.

title: Where the Games Go
description: A 3D globe of North Shore Nostalgia eBay shipments — generalized destinations, great-circle routes, and sales geography from Salem, Massachusetts.

title: SmartPicker
description: Fair classroom cold-calling — random, balanced, reach-the-quiet, or everyone-first modes, with think time, groups, and a participation report that never leaves the browser.

title: Predicting Tomorrow's Housing Crisis
description: A predictive-GIS screening explorer for Massachusetts housing — six tract surfaces (stress, pressure, suitability, development, trend, 2030), MBTA and siting overlays, and live re-weighting of the suitability index in your browser.

title: Tappymaps Arcade
description: Tap-to-color US state and county maps plus a shelf of geography arcade games — locate, recall, duel, and daily draft modes.

title: MCAS Item Bank
description: The full Grade 10 MCAS math item bank — 2,000+ released questions with rendered math, filterable by DOK level, chapter, and standard.

title: Game Vault
description: Visual ROM-library curator: every NA release for 19 classic platforms with box art, highlight tags for top sellers and hidden gems, live terabyte budget bars, and an exportable pick list.
